limitations: Single seed, four new epochs per arm, and already viewed external development sets; no blind-test, significance or universal algorithm claim.

Backbone parameters are fixed while source BatchNorm running buffers update. This does not preserve all CNN state or restore an ImageNet-pretrained representation.
Strict tensor-load, frozen-weight and BatchNorm evidence is read from saved runtime metadata; no checkpoint tensors were loaded again during this CPU audit.
